channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Former star slugger Hideki Matsui to become next manager of Giants in NPB
item.description: Matsui hit 332 home runs during his career in Japan with Yomiuri.

item.title: Japan eyes health checkup support for truant students
item.description: Some municipalities allow truant students to undergo health checkups on days and times when they would not meet other students at school.

item.title: Education ministry to offer one-year teaching license course for working adults
item.description: The ministry is aiming to secure more teachers in Japan by making it easier for working adults to switch careers to teaching.

item.title: Koizumi to meet Finnish defense chief, with nuclear policy shift to top agenda
item.description: The talks come after Finland revised a law allowing nuclear weapons into the country — a decision that came as Japan weighs a similar shift in policy.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
